title: Scripture and Suffering
definition: Scripture and suffering belong together because God's Word gives truth, lament, endurance, comfort, correction, and hope to those who are afflicted.
summary: Scripture helps sufferers bring pain before God while holding to His promises.
christFocus: Christ suffered for His people and gives hope through His cross, resurrection, and promised restoration.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture does not ignore suffering. It gives language for lament, truth for confusion, comfort for grief, warning against despair, and hope for endurance.

God's Word helps sufferers interpret pain without pretending it is easy. It points to Christ, who entered suffering and conquered death.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People in pain may feel abandoned, ashamed, or spiritually disoriented. Scripture and suffering matters because God's Word meets sufferers with truth and compassion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring your suffering to Scripture honestly. Read the Psalms, the Gospels, and the promises of God. Let the Word teach you to lament, trust, and endure.
